positive_oracle: Desktop main process starts one window with OpenMatrix9 title, empty doc, error route
negative_oracle: No GPU/OCCT startup failure should show diagnostic, not silent exit

graphics.fallback_diagnostic_when_absent: GPU adapter unavailable: running the software fallback; 3D performance is not representative

negative_runtime.case: start the UI with a document path that does not exist
negative_runtime.stderr: OM9: OpenMatrix9 could not start (document): I/O: The system cannot find the file specified. (os error 2)

checks_run.focused: cargo test -p om9-app --lib startup / window_identity_guard / --test startup_contract

manual_reviewer_checklist.step: Open OpenMatrix9 from the desktop launcher and watch the first frame
manual_reviewer_checklist.expected: one window titled OpenMatrix9, four Matrix viewports, left menu column in the documented order, status line showing Ready

manual_reviewer_checklist.step: Roll up and expand one menu title bar, then drag one above another
manual_reviewer_checklist.expected: the menu keeps its state, the order changes, the document keeps its objects and undo
manual_reviewer_checklist.observed_by_agent: covered by OM9-L2-01-01 L3-003 tests; not seen by a human reviewer

manual_reviewer_checklist.step: Run a command from the command line, Undo, Redo, then Esc during a preview
manual_reviewer_checklist.expected: object appears, undo/redo restore the same IDs, Esc publishes nothing

manual_reviewer_checklist.step: Trigger a failed start (open a document that does not exist from the launcher)
manual_reviewer_checklist.expected: a visible diagnostic and a receipt, never a silent exit

manual_reviewer_checklist.step: Repeat on a machine with the display scaled to 150% and with a second monitor
manual_reviewer_checklist.expected: no lost or off-screen menu; the layout stays reachable
manual_reviewer_checklist.observed_by_agent: not performed; DPI/multi-monitor acceptance remains open

reviewer.role: project owner (human reviewer), running the app on Windows
